data.name: Indigo
data.description: Indigo Ag is a US-based sustainable agriculture company whose core business is biotrinsic natural microbial seed/foliar treatments and agronomic technology for farmers and agribusinesses. Alongside this, its subsidiary Indigo Carbon PBC runs the Carbon by Indigo soil carbon credit program; since 2018 Indigo has enrolled more than 8 million acres across 28 states, sequestering and abating 2.1 million metric tons of CO₂e, with buyers including Microsoft, Block, JPMorgan, Shopify and Barclays.
